app.already_running: ND104 Studio is already running – see the tray icon.
notify.locked_body: ND104 Studio stopped sending: {reason}. Re-plug the keyboard or use "Check keyboard again".
notify.compatible_body: {model} runs firmware {firmware}, which has not been verified yet. ND104 Studio keeps working as long as all protocol checks pass.
notify.up_to_date_body: ND104 Studio {version} is up to date.
ui.preview.caption: Live preview of the keyboard display (last values sent)
ui.preview.battery_hint: The battery symbol is only a placeholder – ND104 Studio cannot read the battery level or charging state.
ui.dash.connect_hint: Connect the ND104 with a USB cable. Wireless modes are not supported.
ui.weather.name: Name
ui.weather.privacy: Your location is stored only in your local configuration file.
ui.weather.unit_hint: The keyboard display shows the unit of its firmware variant.
ui.weather.manual_hint: Manual / Test sends the values below instead of real weather.
ui.weather.test_hint: Fetches the weather with these settings; nothing is sent to the keyboard.
ui.clock.no_dst: none (fixed mode or zone without DST)
ui.clock.src_system_desc: PC time in the PC time zone
ui.clock.src_timezone_desc: PC time in a chosen time zone
ui.clock.src_ntp_desc: Exact time from a time server
ui.clock.src_manual_desc: PC time plus a fixed offset
ui.clock.ntp_ok: Server reachable – offset to the PC clock: {ms} ms
ui.clock.dst_hint: Automatic follows the time-zone rules and re-syncs the keyboard exactly at the change.
ui.clock.format_hint: 12/24-hour format is part of the keyboard's screen firmware variant.
ui.device.wired_notice: ND104 Studio only works with the keyboard connected by USB cable. 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth are not supported.
ui.device.verified_text: This firmware has been verified with ND104 Studio.
ui.device.compatible_text: This firmware has not been verified yet. ND104 Studio keeps working as long as every protocol check passes and stops immediately otherwise.
ui.device.locked_text: Nothing is sent to the keyboard. Re-plug it or use "Check keyboard again". If it stays locked, please report it with the log file.
ui.device.firmware_update_hint: Compared with the newest file in Chilkey's official download folders; the version list in this project's repository is only used as a fallback.
ui.device.poll: Check for the keyboard every … seconds
ui.general.tagline: Display, lighting and keymap for your Chilkey ND104
ui.general.disclaimer: Unofficial project, not affiliated with Chilkey. MIT licence.
ui.err.fallback_same: Choose a different provider than the main one.
ui.err.interval_positive: A whole number of at least 1.
ui.key.title: API key – {provider}
ui.key.placeholder_replace: Paste a new key to replace the stored one
ui.key.saved: Key stored – the weather is fetched again.
ui.key.hint: Stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the config file or the log. Saved immediately – no Apply needed.
ui.key.missing_notice: This provider needs an API key. Without it, no weather is fetched (or the fallback provider is used).
ui.coverage.germany: Coverage: Germany and nearby (data of the German weather service DWD)
notify.firmware_body: New firmware for {model}: {parts}. ND104 Studio never flashes firmware – see Settings → Device & Firmware for the download and Chilkey's instructions.
notify.firmware_ok_body: The keyboard firmware matches the newest version in the list.
ui.fw.never_flash: ND104 Studio never flashes firmware. Update with Chilkey's tools if you want to; afterwards ND104 Studio checks the new firmware automatically (verified or compatible).
ui.fw.unknown_hint: The display variant could not be recognised, so its firmware cannot be compared with the list.
ui.fw.fallback_note: Chilkey's download folder could not be read for some parts, so the reviewed version list of this project (from {date}) was used instead.
ui.light.intro: Switch the keyboard lighting on or off and choose effect, brightness, speed and colour. Every change is sent right away and stored in the keyboard, like in Chilkey's web driver.
ui.light.not_connected: Connect the keyboard with the USB cable to change this.
ui.light.bottom_hint: Light around the keyboard and the light bar below Del / End / PgDn ("bottom lighting" in Chilkey's web driver)
ui.light.effects_hint: Brightness works with every effect; the colour only with effects that use it. Switching on restores the last effect.
ui.pic.intro: Show your own picture or animated GIF on the keyboard screen. ND104 Studio checks and converts the file before anything is sent.
ui.pic.requirements: PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP · up to 2 MB · GIF up to {max} frames · any size, scaled to 320 × 172
ui.pic.problem.file_too_large: The file is too large ({size}); at most {max} are allowed.
ui.pic.problem.unsupported_format: This file type is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP.
ui.pic.problem.too_many_frames: The GIF has {frames} frames; at most {max} are allowed. Shorten it and try again.
ui.pic.problem.too_large_after_conversio: Even after compression the picture needs {size}; at most {max} fit. Use fewer frames.
ui.pic.note.enlarged: The picture is smaller than the screen and is enlarged – it may look blurry.
ui.pic.note.cropped: Different aspect ratio: the edges are cut off. Choose "Show whole picture" to keep them.
ui.pic.note.bars: Different aspect ratio: black bars are added.
ui.pic.note.delay_adjusted: Some frame times were adjusted to what the screen supports (0.02–2.55 s).
ui.pic.note.reduced_quality: The frames were compressed more to fit the screen's limit.
ui.pic.send_hint: Replaces the picture stored on the screen. Keep the cable connected while sending; time and weather updates wait until it is done.
ui.pic.done: Picture stored on the screen. Switch to the picture page on the keyboard to see it.
ui.light.own_colors: This effect uses its own colours.
ui.pic.animation: Animation with {frames} frames – shown as on the screen
ui.keymap.title: Keymap backup
ui.keymap.intro: Saves the assignment of every key on all 6 layers and the knob to a file, and puts it back later – for example after trying something in Chilkey's web driver. Restoring shows first what would change and writes only the differences, then reads everything back to check. Macros are not included.
ui.keymap.other_firmware: The backup was made with keyboard firmware {backup}; the keyboard now runs {now}. Key codes may mean something else after a firmware change – only restore if you know they match.
ui.keymap.identical: The keyboard already matches this backup – nothing to do.
ui.keymap.restore_hint: The keyboard stores every change immediately. Keep the cable connected until it is done.
ui.keymap.restored: Keymap restored and checked: {n} changes written.
ui.km.intro: Choose what each key, the knob and the round button do – on all six layers. Changes are collected first and written together; before writing, the current keymap is saved as an automatic backup. The labels only change what this page shows.
ui.km.detect_prompt: Press the key directly right of the left Shift key (Esc cancels).
ui.km.detect_iso: ISO keyboard detected (extra key next to Shift).
ui.km.detect_unknown: That key could not be recognised – it may be remapped. Choose ISO or ANSI yourself.
ui.km.knob_layers: The keyboard stores turning actions only for layers 0–{n}; pressing works on every layer.
ui.km.select_key: Click a key, the knob or the round button in the drawing.
ui.km.fn_locked: Fn stays Fn on layer 0 – otherwise the other layers could no longer be reached.
ui.km.auto_backup: Before writing, the current keymap is saved automatically (the last 20 are kept).
ui.km.labels_builtin_hint: {name} is a built-in label set. To change labels, make your own copy first.
ui.km.labels_own_hint: Click a key to change its label in “{name}”.
ui.km.select_key_label: Click a key in the drawing.
ui.km.profiles_hint: A profile is a complete keymap, e.g. for a game or an application. Loading one shows its differences as changes – nothing is written until you confirm.
ui.km.profile_loaded: Profile “{name}” loaded – check the changes, then write them.
ui.km.lighting_animated: Animated lighting effects are not shown in the drawing – only a single colour is.
ui.kbs.title: Keyboard settings
ui.kbs.intro: Debounce and sleep times, with the values Chilkey's web driver offers. A change is stored in the keyboard right away.
ui.kbs.hint: Sleep times count from the last key press. Debounce filters the double signals of a key that bounces; raise the time if keys type twice. "–": the keyboard does not report this value.
